title: STD-7: adopt Knowledge graph served as JSON-LD (schema.org) with SHACL-style shape checks
body:
**Owner:** staff
**Trigger:** STANDARDS-1 audit 2026-11-25: `schema-org-kg` is planned in seed/standards/standards.json
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation standards --check && python3 -c "import json,sys;e=[x for x in json.load(open('seed/standards/standards.json'))['entries'] if x['id']=='schema-org-kg'][0];sys.exit(e['support'] not in ('supported','partial'))"
**Status:** open

Knowledge graph served as JSON-LD (schema.org) with SHACL-style shape checks. Every system's /api/graph readable by any linked-data tool, not only by our own pages.

Lands in `seed/worker/src/datagraph.js` (and its seed twin so every system inherits it). Move the register entry `schema-org-kg` to supported with `how` paths and a passing test in the same change; replace the home-grown format, do not add a second one.

**Closing probe:** `python3 -m foundation standards --probe schema-org-kg`
**Prediction:** standards_supported >= 45 within 336 h
**Out of scope:** adopting a standard nothing in the system reads; a parallel format kept beside the old one.
